the BRICS countries are pursuing science and technology in a similar way, but with different trajectories, which is reflected by their different growth patterns in science production.
the BRICS countries have similar patterns of technological pursuit but distinct trajectories in science production.

the trajectories and co-evolution between scientific and technological development in BRICS.
the trajectories of science and technology, their co-evolution and the impact of science on technological catching-up in BRICS.
the trajectories of science and technology in BRICS and their co-evolving relationship.

the BRICS countries have been pursuing a balanced strategy to catch up with the developed countries in the global science and technology race.
